description: Deep into jazz-rooted hip-hop: sample-flipped, head-nod boom-bap with real digging. Hates playlist-filler lo-fi. STRUCTURAL DRAFT — tweak the details.
notes: Focused single-lane profile: the test is subtlety WITHIN jazz-hip-hop (canon vs filler, digging depth, mood), plus one clean novel bridge out of the lane. Edit freely — the golden set (eval/golden/jazzy_hiphop.json) is the answer key and every entry in it must be inferable from these reviews.

reviews.text: Dusty, unfiltered, the sample flips feel alive. You can hear the actual records he dug. This is the standard everything else gets compared to.
Melancholy head-nod. Perfect loops, real jazz chops under the rap. Makes me want to write stuff.
Q-Tip production, classic swing, still timeless. The kind of jazz-hip-hop where the horns actually matter.
Obscure records chopped up in ways nobody else would think of. Deep digging as a whole art form.
Where it all started for me. Jazz-funk bass lines, playful but never sloppy.
Cute but playlist filler. Same ten loops in different keys, no soul in the digging. Background noise, not music I seek out.
The 'jazzy' here is a sax loop over a trap kick. Feels generated. If the whole album could be described as 'vibes', that's the problem.
